If the magnetic field energy density decreases more rapidly than the external radiation field energy density, the EC ($\gamma$-rays) peak could be delayed relative to the synchrotron (optical) peak, resulting in a negative time lag.
The small number of local maxima in X-rays is mainly related to the relatively low sensitivity of *Swift*-BAT.
